standard.summary: 实验性编辑训练使用成对数据：source 是原图或参考 latent，target 是编辑后的监督目标，instruction 描述编辑动作。
standard.effect: 本地 paired edit dataset 推荐包含 source/、target/、可选 masks/、可选 captions/ 和 metadata.jsonl。source 与 target 通过相同文件名 stem 配对，instruction 可来自 metadata.jsonl 或 captions/*.txt。
standard.whenToUse: 想训练 Edit-LoRA、edit adapter 或蒸馏小型 edit 路径时。适合先做小规模 paired fixture，验证局部改色、材质替换、风格迁移或背景替换。
standard.avoidWhen: 只有普通单图 caption 数据时先不要开启。没有 source/target 配对会导致编辑目标不明确。

standard_en.summary: Experimental edit training uses paired data: source is the original image or reference latent, target is the supervised post-edit result, and instruction describes the edit.
standard_en.effect: A local paired edit dataset should hold source/, target/, optionally masks/, optionally captions/, and metadata.jsonl. source and target pair on a matching filename stem, and the instruction can come from metadata.jsonl or from captions/*.txt.
standard_en.whenToUse: When training an Edit-LoRA or an edit adapter, or distilling a small edit path. Start with a small paired fixture to check local recolouring, material replacement, style transfer or background replacement.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave it off when all you have is ordinary single-image caption data. Without source/target pairing the edit target is undefined.

advanced.principle: edit_dataset_manifest.py 只构建和验证 manifest，不解码图像、不调用生成器。manifest sample 会转换为 normalize_edit_batch() 可消费的 batch dict，后续由模型族 adapter 决定 source/target encode 和 forward 表面。
advanced.intervention: 数据集合同层提供 source_image_path、target_image_path、instruction、edit_mask、source_prompt、target_prompt 和 metadata。
advanced.expectedImpact: 让不同模型族共享同一种编辑数据描述，避免为 Anima、SDXL、SD15 分别发明数据格式。
advanced.tradeoffs: manifest 只证明配对和字段可读，真实质量仍依赖 paired 数据、mask 质量和模型先验。

advanced_en.principle: edit_dataset_manifest.py only builds and validates the manifest — it decodes no images and calls no generators. Manifest samples convert to batch dicts consumable by normalize_edit_batch(); the model-family adapter then decides source/target encode and the forward surface.
advanced_en.intervention: The dataset contract layer provides source_image_path, target_image_path, instruction, edit_mask, source_prompt, target_prompt, and metadata.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Lets different model families share one edit-data description instead of inventing separate formats for Anima, SDXL, and SD15.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The manifest only proves pairing and field readability; real quality still depends on paired data, mask quality, and model priors.
